hero.subtitle: Our Story
hero.description: Asma Perfumes is a Nairobi-born luxury fragrance house dedicated to creating scents that transcend the ordinary. We believe every person carries a story — and the right fragrance brings it to life.

values.title: Craftsmanship
values.desc: Every fragrance is meticulously blended by master perfumers using rare, ethically sourced ingredients from around the world.

values.title: Passion
values.desc: Born from a deep love for scent — each creation tells a story, evokes a memory, and captures an emotion.

values.title: Heritage
values.desc: Rooted in the rich perfumery traditions of the Middle East, reimagined for the modern connoisseur.

values.title: Excellence
values.desc: We never compromise. From ingredient selection to the final bottle, every detail is perfected.

founderQuote.quote: A truly great fragrance doesn't just sit on skin — it becomes part of who you are. That's what we create at Asma.
founderQuote.name: Asma
founderQuote.title: Founder & Creative Director

milestones.title: The Beginning
milestones.desc: Asma Perfumes was born in Nairobi — a small studio with a grand vision for East African luxury fragrance.

milestones.title: First Collection
milestones.desc: Midnight Oud launched to instant acclaim, establishing our signature of dark, complex compositions.

milestones.title: Expanding Horizons
milestones.desc: Velvet Rose & Amber Noir collections introduced, broadening our palette from florals to rich orientals.

milestones.title: The Atelier
milestones.desc: Opened our dedicated fragrance atelier in Nairobi, where every scent is now crafted by hand.

milestones.title: 25 Signatures
milestones.desc: Our catalog reached 25 signature fragrances across four curated collections, each a masterpiece.

process.title: Source
process.desc: We source the finest raw materials — Mysore sandalwood, Grasse roses, Ethiopian frankincense — from trusted partners across continents.

process.title: Compose
process.desc: Our master perfumers blend each composition by hand, testing hundreds of variations until the scent is perfect.

process.title: Present
process.desc: Each fragrance is housed in hand-finished bottles, designed to be as beautiful as the scent within.

cta.title: Find Your
cta.description: Explore our curated collections and discover the fragrance that tells your story.
